选项主张：无论候选人处于哪个级别，面试官的期望标准都完全一致。
选项主张：Staff+ 候选人可以跳过高层设计，直接进入深挖环节。
optionMeanings_en: Senior races through the high-level design.
Senior candidates are tested purely on breadth, Staff+ purely on depth.
The bar is exactly the same no matter what level the candidate is at.
Staff+ candidates can skip the high-level design and jump straight to deep dives.
